name: CSOAI Temporal Gap Audit
description: GF-04 deterministic agentic temporal-gap audit: ACTION_TO_RECORD (record issued >1h after its event), ANCHOR_STALENESS (anchored >24h after cited data), UPDATE_GAP (single-state artifact spanning >1h of measurements). Deterministic timestamp deltas, no LLM; a file with no timestamps is UNKNOWN, never 'no gap'. Pairs with corpus-anchor drift.
honesty: deterministic timestamp-delta analysis only; indicators with evidence, never verdicts; untimestamped = UNKNOWN
